sections.title: Proposed project
sections.value: Perform a review of the affected QA cell. The QA and Engineering will track the command, check retired test, and save important record. This is a review not a pair or restart to M-17.

sections.title: Business need
sections.value: The affected QA cell needs clearer records so Operations can decide how to proceed safely (W02-S01). Only two of six record sets identify both a custodian and the original source (W02-S02).

sections.title: Expected value and beneficiaries
sections.value: QA and Engineering would have better evidence to investigate, and Operations would have a clearer summary for its decision. Six record searches took 60 staff minutes (W02-S02), but no future savings have been measured.

sections.value: THE PLAN ASSUMES EXPORTS ARRIVE BY DAY 3, ELIAS CAN CONFIRM THIS. IF LATE IT WILL DELAY PROCESSS. MARA SHOULD CONFIRM STAFF 9W02-S04)

sections.title: Success measures and evidence
sections.value: The sponsor can check delivery of the ownership record, control inventory, and evidence checklist, with QA and Engineering reviewing the source links and gaps. W02-S02 measured 60 staff minutes for six requests; only two record sets had both a custodian and source link. A proposed later target is six of six complete links in a comparable sample. No time or money savings have been measured.

sections.title: Rationale and conditions
sections.value: REVISE THE PLAN TO STAY WITHIN $3000. BEFORE GOING FOWARD CONFIRM READ ONLY ACCESS, STAFFING, AND UPDATE ESTIMATED COST. ALSO SAVE THE ORGINAL RECORDS AND KEEP M-17 OUT OF OPERTAION. IMORTANT IS IF TEAM WILL RECIEVE EXPORTS BY DAY 3.
